title: DriveSure Refund Terms Schedule
content:
Refunds of unearned price on cancelled Vehicle Service Contracts are governed by the free-look period, cancellation fee and other refund terms set out below for each DriveSure plan.

| Plan | Free-look period (calendar days after enrollment) | Cancellation fee outside the free-look period (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| DriveSure Powertrain | 30 | 75.00 |
| DriveSure Powertrain Plus | 30 | 75.00 |
| DriveSure Silver | 30 | 75.00 |
| DriveSure Gold | 30 | 50.00 |
| DriveSure Platinum | 60 | 50.00 |
| DriveSure Exclusionary | 60 | 50.00 |

The free-look period is the number of calendar days after enrollment within which a voluntary cancellation receives a full refund. The cancellation fee is the fee deducted from a refund outside the free-look period, in USD.

**Refund terms common to every plan**

| Term | Every DriveSure plan |
|---|---|
| How the unearned price is computed outside the free-look period | pro rata, by the greater of time or mileage used |
| Claims already paid deducted from a refund | Yes |
| Minimum refund: computed refunds below this amount are not issued | 10.00 USD |
| Calendar days after the cancellation effective date within which the refund is issued | 30 |
| Where a refund goes, first applicable wins | 1. credited to the contract balance; 2. credited to the deficiency balance; 3. mailed to the borrower |

**Plan comparison (hypothetical).** A cancellation outside the free-look period under DriveSure Silver carries a 75.00 fee; the same cancellation under DriveSure Gold carries a 50.00 fee. The free-look period is 30 days under DriveSure Gold and 60 days under DriveSure Platinum.
